review_candidates.title: VP/SVP, Cloud/Network Engineer, Technology Group
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Hand every build over to Network Operations against agreed acceptance criteria (monitoring, runbooks, as-built records and knowledge transfer), with early-life support until sign-off What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role?
eligibility_evidence: As a Cloud Network Engineer, you will own the design and engineering of GIC's cloud and hybrid networks: landing-zone architecture in AWS (and increasingly Azure), AWS Outposts in our data centres, and the hybrid edge where cloud meets our WAN.
Own the hybrid edge: Direct Connect (and ExpressRoute where applicable), edge and colocation routing, BGP policy, redundancy and tested failover between cloud, data centres and the WAN.
Engineer cloud DNS and hybrid name resolution (Route 53 Resolver, private hosted zones) in line with the enterprise DNS architecture owned by Network Services.

Build cloud network observability (flow logs, reachability analysis, alerting), manage capacity and cost, act as senior escalation point for hybrid issues, and produce design and audit evidence aligned to MAS TRM.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Hand every build over to Network Operations against agreed acceptance criteria (monitoring, runbooks, as-built records and knowledge transfer), with early-life support until sign-off What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role? Deep hands-on expertise with AWS networking services (VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, PrivateLink, AWS Network Firewall / Gateway Load Balancer or equivalent). Hands-on AWS Outposts deployment experience, or Azure, GCP or multi-cloud networking.
